name: powerhouse-predictive-proof-mesh-delivery
purpose: Ship safe Powerhouse changes in minutes by combining event-driven admission, predictive risk scoring, isolated parallel agent cells, proof capsules, one rolling candidate per conflict contract, adaptive blocking gates, autonomous recovery, protected exact-head promotion, production readback and measured self-optimization.
trigger_when: building or fixing code, portal, website, automation, Brain or documentation
multiple agents or chats are working in parallel
CI queue, drift, timeout, zero-run head, partial-start or stale PR threatens lead time
a bounded safe change can use FAST or TURBO delivery

delivery_mesh.coordinator: owns canonical intent, conflict contracts, candidate identity, promotion and definition of done
delivery_mesh.frontend_cell: isolated UI implementation with targeted visual/browser proof
delivery_mesh.backend_cell: isolated API/data/runtime implementation with contract/security proof
delivery_mesh.qa_cell: risk-derived tests, oracle-quality checks and proof-capsule validation
delivery_mesh.release_cell: event-driven critical workflow admission, stale-run cancellation, exact-head promotion and rollback/readback
delivery_mesh.learning_cell: root-cause attribution, telemetry calibration, prevention and skill writeback
delivery_mesh.integration_unit: one rolling candidate per conflict contract
delivery_mesh.shared_truth: all cells consume one canonical execution packet and write evidence to the same lineage

proof_capsule.reuse_rule: Immutable evidence may be reused only when exact identity, contract, config, schema, dependency and gate versions still match.

operating_model.safe_parallelism: parallel until changed-path, contract, dependency or mutable-resource overlap
operating_model.promotion: automatic protected exact-head BG169 promotion when blocking profile is green
operating_model.rollback: automatic last-known-good recovery on relevant production regression
operating_model.watchdog: event-driven first; scheduled supervisor only as fallback

mandatory_behavior: Create one execution packet and proof capsule before fan-out so every agent works from the same identities and contracts.
Run frontend, backend, QA, documentation and release preparation in isolated parallel cells unless a real path, contract, dependency or mutable-resource collision exists.
Reuse the existing rolling lane for the obligation/conflict contract; do not open a parallel recovery PR.
On pull-request head creation or synchronization, immediately ensure Required and BRAIN critical workflows are admitted; do not wait for the periodic watchdog.
Cancel superseded CI immediately; a stale run is not useful work.
If an exact head has no critical workflow run, or only one of Required/BRAIN started, autonomously dispatch the missing critical workflow on the same lineage.
If main moves without overlap, keep the tested candidate; do not rebuild merely for generic drift.
If there is real path/contract/dependency overlap, refresh only that rolling lane from current main and preserve non-conflicting tested work.
Use FAST/TURBO only for bounded non-protected changes and run only changed tests plus immutable safety guards.
Never admit migrations, auth, security, RLS, permissions, secrets, delivery-control-plane or unknown material scope to TURBO.
Do not run unrelated broad regression suites in the safe pre-merge critical path; run them in shadow/post-merge assurance.
Promote immediately when the exact-head blocking profile is green; do not wait for unrelated shadow assurance.
Treat queue, zero-run, partial-start, stale-run, timeout and merge-drift incidents as recoverable delivery events rather than waiting states.
Regression tests must target forbidden behavior or violated contracts, never incidental implementation words that create false positives.
Predict conflict, queue and gate risk before fan-out and use the prediction to choose parallelism and the smallest safe blocking profile.
Measure prediction error, queue time, reruns, conflicts, false-positive oracles, rollback, shadow failures and lead time after every material delivery.
Write timing, failure, root cause, outcome, prevention and calibrated threshold changes back to Powerhouse learning.
Retain an optimization only when safe lead time improves without correctness, security, data-integrity or production-readback regression.
Promote only the exact tested head; immediately continue through production readback, outcome evidence, learning writeback and next-agent discoverability.
forbidden_patterns: one PR per agent for overlapping work
waiting for scheduled recovery when a PR event can admit critical workflows immediately
global full-suite blocking for a bounded safe delta
rebase or rebuild on non-overlapping main drift
opening a new recovery PR for the same obligation
broad lexical test guards that match harmless primitives
weakening security, schema, data-integrity or production-readback gates for speed
